ObjectStates.Name: PlayerPawn
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
info = {
  hpColour = "#00FFFF",
  startingHealth = 10,
  buttonLabels = true
}

----#include Figures/CharacterMini
statuses = {}

health = {
   value = nil,
   max = nil
}

immunities = {}

----#include Conditions
function statusClick(player, value, id)
  local status = statuses[id]
  if status ~= nil then
    if status.current > 0 then
      status.current = status.current - 1
      updateStatus(id, status)
    end
  end
end

function addStatuses()
  local conditions = getObjectFromGUID("2e9944").getTable("Conditions")
  for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
    print(k)
    if not conditions[k] then
      statuses[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for key, condition in pairs(conditions) do
    local existing = statuses[key]
    if existing == nil or existing == false then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 0,
      }
    elseif existing == true then
      statuses[key] = {
        max = condition.max,
        current = 1,
      }
    elseif exising then
      existing.max = condition.max
    end
  end
end

function createStatusButtons()
  xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()
  local conditionsPanel = findInXmlTable(xml, function(o)
    return o.attributes.id == "Conditions"
  end)
  if conditionsPanel then
    local buttonAdded = false
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      if not findInTable(conditionsPanel.children, function(o) return o.attributes.id == k end) then
        table.insert(conditionsPanel.children, createStatusButton(k))
        buttonAdded = true
      end
    end
    if buttonAdded then
      self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)
    end
  end
  Wait.frames(function()
    for k,v in pairs(statuses) do
      updateStatus(k, v)
    end
  end, 2)
end

function createStatusButton(name)
  return {
    tag = "Button",
    attributes = {
      id = name,
      active = false,
      onClick = "statusClick",
      label = "1",
    },
    children = {
      {
        tag = "Image",
        attributes = {
          image = name,
          preserveAspect = true
        },
        children = {},
      },
      {
        tag = "Text",
        attributes = {
          id = name .. "Count",
          color = "White",
          offsetXY = "100 -100"
        }
      }
    }
  }
end


function checkStats()
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j == true then
      self.UI.setAttribute(i, "active", true)
    end
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

local collided = {}

function onCollisionEnter(a)
  if a.collision_object.getQuantity() ~= -1 then
    return
  end
  Wait.condition(
    function()
      --found = do nothing
    end,
    function()
      return collided[a.collision_object.guid] == true
    end,
    0.1,
    function()
      local newState = a.collision_object.getName()
      if newState == "Summon Marker" and canBeASummon then
         self.UI.setAttribute("summonIcon", "active", true)
         a.collision_object.destruct()
      else
        local status = statuses[newState]
        if status ~= nil and not immunities[newState:lower()] then
          if status.current ~= status.max then
            status.current = status.current + 1
            collided[a.collision_object.guid] = true
            Wait.time(function() collided[a.collision_object.guid] = nil end, 1)
            a.collision_object.destruct()
            updateStatus(newState, status)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  )
end

function updateStatus(name, status)
  if status.current > 0 then
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", true)
    if status.current > 1 then
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", tostring(status.current))
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
    end
  else
    self.UI.setAttribute(name, "active", false)
    self.UI.setAttribute(name .. "Count", "text", "")
  end
  updatePanelWidth()
end

function updatePanelWidth()
  Wait.frames(function()
    self.UI.setAttribute("statePanel", "width", 260 + (getStatsCount() - 1) * 280)
  end, 1)
end

function getStatsCount()
  local count = 0
  for i, j in pairs(statuses) do
    if j.current > 0 then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end


function findInTable(table, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end
end

function findInXmlTable(xml, f)
  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if f(v) then
      return v
    end
  end

  for k,v in pairs(xml) do
    if v.children then
      local x = findInXmlTable(v.children, f)
      if x then
        return x
      end
    end
  end
end

----#include Conditions

function onSave()
  local save_state = JSON.encode({health = health, statuses = statuses})
  self.script_state = save_state
end

function onLoad(save_state)
  if save_state ~= "" and self.getDescription() ~= "" then
    saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    if saved_data.statuses then
      statuses = saved_data.statuses
    end
    if saved_data.health then
      health = saved_data.health
    end
  else
    health.value = info.startingHealth
    health.max = info.startingHealth
  end
  Wait.condition(setHealth, checkLoaded)
  addStatuses()
  Wait.condition(createStatusButtons, function() return self.UI.getXml() ~= "" end)
  Wait.condition(updatePanelWidth, checkLoaded)
  Wait.condition(function() self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "fillImageColor", info.hpColour) end, checkLoaded)
  createBtns()
end


function checkLoaded()
  if not self.loading_custom and not self.spawning then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function createBtns()
  plus = "+"
  minus = "-"
  if not info.buttonLabels then
    plus = ""
    minus = ""
  end

  local buttonParameter = {click_function = "add", function_owner = self, position = { - 0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}, label = plus,
  width = 250, height = 250, font_size = 300, color = {0, 0, 0, 0}, font_color = {0, 255, 0, 100}}
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
  buttonParameter.position = {0.2, 0.2, - 0.5}
  buttonParameter.click_function = "sub"
  buttonParameter.label = minus
  self.createButton(buttonParameter)
end

function add(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "add")
end

function sub(obj, color, alt_click)
  onClick(color, -1, "sub")
end

function maxHp(player, value, id)
  if id == "addMax" then
    health.value = health.value + 1
    health.max = health.max + 1
  elseif id == "subMax" then
    health.value = health.value - 1
    health.max = health.max - 1
  end
  -- getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
  setHealth()
end

function onClick(player, value, id)
  if id == "editButton" then
    if self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == "False" or self.UI.getAttribute("editPanel", "active") == nil then
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", true)
    else
      self.UI.setAttribute("editPanel", "active", false)
    end
  else
    local oldHP = health.value
    local tabInfo = getNotebookTabs()
    local tab = ""
    if id == "add" then
      health.value = health.value + 1
    elseif id == "sub" then
      health.value = health.value - 1
    end
    if health.value > health.max then
      health.value = health.max
    end
    if health.value < 0 then
      health.value = 0
    end

    for _, t in pairs(tabInfo) do
      if t.title == "Options" then
        tab = t.body
      end
    end
    if tab ~= "" then
      local settings = tab:match("broadcast hp changes:(%a+)")
      --all/chars/monster/none
      if settings == "all" or settings == "chars" then
        local color = "Green"
        if player ~= nil and player ~= -1 and player.color == nil and Player[player] then
          color = player
        end
        if id == "add" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at max HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " gained 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        elseif id == "sub" then
          if oldHP == health.value then
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " is already at 0 HP.", color)
          else
            broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " lost 1 HP. From " .. oldHP .. "HP to " .. health.value .. "HP.", color)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    -- getObjectFromGUID("75ab50").call("changeHP", {self.getName(), health.value})
    setHealth()
  end
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
end


function setHealth()
  self.UI.setAttribute("progressBar", "percentage", health.value / health.max * 100)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "text", health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.setDescription(health.value .. "/" .. health.max)
  self.UI.setAttribute("editButton", "textColor", "#000000")
  self.UI.setAttribute("panel", "position", "0 0 -" .. self.getBounds().size.y / self.getScale().y * 110 + 50)
end
